title: Proceedings before Settlement Commission to be judicial proceedings
text:
245L. Proceedings before Settlement Commission to be judicial proceedings.—Any proceeding

under this Chapter before the Settlement Commission shall be deemed to be a judicial proceeding within
[the meaning of sections 193 and 228, and for the purposes of section 196, of the Indian Penal Code (45 of](javascript:ShowMainContent('Act',%20'CMSID',%20'102120000000064309',%20'');)
1860).
